propositions: The citation section in docs/writing-a-passing-plan.md does not document that the required upstream edge must be DIRECT.
The verifier det_citation._edge_verified correctly enforces direct-edge-only checks with no transitive recursion, but this behavior is not reflected in the shipped documentation.
A ticket with a transitive/indirect dependency on a cited ticket fails citation verification because the edge is not direct, with no warning in the doc to explain why.
Adding explicit mention of 'direct' and 'transitive/indirect' to the citation section will align the documentation with the already-correct verifier implementation.
